title: China's Highest Highway: 915 km Above 4,000 m | China Travel Expert
description:
The G219 is the world's highest highway — and it does not care how fit you think you are.

Running roughly 2,900 km from Yecheng in Xinjiang to Lhasa in Tibet, it averages over 4,500 metres above sea level, with about 915 km sitting above 4,000 m and its passes climbing past 5,300 m across five peaks over 5,000 m. Fuel, food and medical help can be hundreds of kilometres apart, and the real danger isn't the road — it's altitude sickness when you climb too fast. Gain height slowly and it's one of the most jaw-dropping drives on earth.

🧭 Expert Tip: budget three days to gain the altitude, not one — sleep low, drive high, and carry a day's extra fuel, water and warm layers. Many travellers also take a doctor-advised acetazolamide course; ask your doctor before you go.

全世界海拔最高的公路：G219 平均超过4500米，915公里在4000米以上——上得太快，高原反应才是真的危险。
